top1.title: 【2026-11-11】Google、Gemini 4 Carbonの提供拡大　複数エージェントの協調機能も予告
top1.lead1: GoogleがGemini 4 Carbonを有料開発者・企業やAI Ultra利用者へ展開。複雑な開発や科学研究を狙う。
top1.lead2: Antigravityでは複数エージェントの協調機能もプレビュー。性能評価はGoogleの説明に基づき、実利用の費用はトークン消費量にも左右される。

top10.title: [2026-11-11] Google expands Gemini 4 Carbon availability, previews multi-agent collaboration features
top10.summary: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon to paying developers, enterprise customers and AI Ultra users. It positions the model for complex development and research tasks and is also previewing agent collaboration features.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] Anthropic announces Claude Meetings and other tools to support meetings, spreadsheets and collaboration
top10.summary: Anthropic has released beta versions of Claude Meetings, which performs tasks during meetings, along with Whiteboards and Sheets. Meetings is available for Team and Enterprise customers and supports Google Meet.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] OpenAI introduces business profiles and Business Hub in ChatGPT
top10.summary: OpenAI has launched Business Hub in beta. It supports reviewing and updating company information and tracking usage trends. Eligible businesses can also create dedicated agents to answer customer questions.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] Google announces new AI TPUs with enhanced confidential computing and larger memory capacity
top10.summary: Google has announced TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max. The 8tx was designed with AMD and emphasizes protecting confidential data, while the 8i Max increases memory capacity and other capabilities to broaden its inference applications.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] PSI explores commercializing AI-driven scientific discovery as researchers solve a long-standing quantum computing conjecture
top10.summary: PSI researchers reportedly used Fable 5.2 to solve a quantum computing conjecture. A formalization in Lean is presented, while experimental validation is still considered necessary for real-world physics.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] Anthropic's seven co-founders plan to sell about $250 million in shares each in IPO
top10.summary: According to a new S-1 filing, the seven co-founders plan to sell approximately 3.38 million shares each. At the midpoint of the expected price range, that amounts to about $250 million each. The founders will collectively retain a majority of voting rights.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] Oura to acquire AI healthcare company Counsel Health for $625 million
top10.summary: Oura has announced its acquisition of Counsel Health. It aims to expand healthcare services combining AI and physicians into areas including preventive care, acute care and chronic conditions. Completion is expected by the end of 2027.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] eBay may be restricting access by external AI agents; The Verge reproduces connection failure
top10.summary: The Verge reproduced Meta's Muse being unable to retrieve eBay listing information. eBay acknowledged restricting some agent access but did not directly answer whether any new restrictions had been imposed.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] Meta's Muse AI agent adds support for Apple Watch and Wear OS
top10.summary: Meta is rolling out Muse to Apple Watch and Wear OS. Users can access it from smartwatches through voice calls, text and voice input for assistance with tasks such as email and scheduling.

top10.title: [2026-11-11] Analysis: Experts assess allegations surrounding Nvidia's chief and implications for the US AI industry
top10.summary: The Verge examines management and national security risks surrounding Nvidia. Experts express concern about effects on supply and policy, while noting that there is no public evidence that the CEO himself diverted chips subject to regulatory restrictions.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
